message.content: debug why traefik isn't picking up the docker labels

Most likely: the container isn't on the same docker network as Traefik. `docker network inspect proxy` and confirm the service is listed. Also check `traefik.enable=true` is on the container, not the service.
yeah it was the network — both moved to proxy and it works now
Good. While you're in there, add `traefik.http.routers.<name>.entrypoints=websecure` so http traffic gets redirected automatically.
